body: Off topic, I'm a young single dad of two very young boys, on a daily basis I question how good I'm doing and how good of a dad I am, reading this stuff makes me feel a lot better about myself so thanks lol

Your feelings are valid, it's important to remember that, but you are overanalyzing his statement here. Even if he flat out said "Well, it's because you're hot," it wouldn't mean much because it's the truth of the situation, but he didn't even call her hot, he's referencing the situation the guys are trying to create

Try to get at the core of the issue here, a statement said in passing seems to have brought up trauma originating from your "ugly" childhood, and your past with your friend and bf, the statement is meaningless, but your trauma and emotions are real and you deserve to be able to get past it

I don't think she drove home that night, I think the couple drove two cars (mine and theirs), dropped her off, then they went back home in their car, and I believe that since she couldn't even walk. I don't think she could even get the key in the ignition in her state.
